title.es: El de cuando Marta se aparta de la empresa
title.en: The One Where Marta Steps Away From the Company

description.es: Marta le comunica a Tasio que va a apartarse temporalmente de sus funciones. Le cede su papel en la empresa a Carmen.
description.en: Marta informs Tasio that she is going to step away from her duties temporarily. She hands over her role in the company to Carmen.
